notes.title: Patch Notes 9/14/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Kandagawa Jet Girls.
BuildID: 5531103 (Ver. 1.02)

This update addresses the following issues:
-When the graphics options were set to lower specifications and the frame rate exceeded 200 FPS in a race, it would become difficult to steer the Tamakaze.
-During casual matches, if a guest lost connection after the host proceeded to start the race, the guest’s game would crash and the race would begin with 5 teams.
-Made minor text fixes in English and Korean

notes.title: Patch Notes 8/27/2020
notes.content:
We have released a new version of Kandagawa Jet Girls.

BuildID: 5466392

This update addresses the following issues:
-The game would not function properly if players were not connected to the internet or playing in offline mode.
-An error message when players were disconnected from online play did not always display correctly.
